elements.name: material.constant_info

elements.description: The value of a user constant returned in a material.constant_info entry by material.get_constants. A scalar constant is returned as a vector4 or matrix4; a shader constant array is returned as an array of those values. Non-user constants do not include a value field.
elements.examples:
for _, constant in ipairs(material.get_constants(self.material)) do
    if constant.value then
        pprint(constant.name, constant.value)
    end
end

elements.description: Material constant types
elements.name: material.CONSTANT_TYPE

elements.description: A value accepted by material.set_constants when updating a shader constant. Use a number or vector for user vector constants, a matrix4 for matrix constants, and an array to update a shader constant array.
elements.examples:
material.set_constants(self.material, {
    tint = { value = vmath.vector4(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1) },
    weights = { value = { 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1 } }
})
elements.name: material.constant_value

elements.brief: gets shader constants from a material
elements.description:
Returns a table of all the shader constants in the material. This function will return all the shader constants
that are used in both the vertex and the fragment shaders.
elements.examples:
Get the shader constants from a material specified as a resource property 
go.property("my_material", resource.material())

function init(self)
    local constants = material.get_constants(self.my_material)
end

elements.brief: sets shader constants in a material
elements.description: Sets shader constants in a material, if the constants exist.
elements.examples:
Set a shader constant in a material specified as a resource property 
go.property("my_material", resource.material())

function update(self)
    -- update the 'tint' constant
    material.set_constants(self.my_material, {
        tint = { value = vmath.vector4(1, 0, 0, 1) }
    })
    -- change the type of the 'view_proj' constant to CONSTANT_TYPE_USER_MATRIX4 so the renderer can set our custom data
    material.set_constants(self.my_material, {
        view_proj = { value = self.my_view_proj, type = material.CONSTANT_TYPE_USER_MATRIX4 }
    })
end
elements.name: material.set_constants

parameters.doc: Shader constant updates keyed by constant name. Partial updates are supported.
parameters.name: constants

elements.brief: sets texture samplers in a material
elements.description: Sets texture samplers in a material, if the samplers exist. Use this function to change the settings of texture samplers. To set actual textures that should be bound to the samplers, use the material.set_textures function instead.
elements.examples:
Configures a sampler in a material specified as a resource property 
go.property("my_material", resource.material())

function init(self)
    material.set_samplers(self.my_material, {
        texture_sampler = { u_wrap = graphics.TEXTURE_WRAP_REPEAT, v_wrap = graphics.TEXTURE_WRAP_MIRRORED_REPEAT }
    })
end
elements.name: material.set_samplers

parameters.doc: Sampler updates keyed by sampler name. Partial updates are supported.
parameters.name: samplers

elements.description: Sets textures in a material, if the samplers exist.
elements.examples:
Set a texture in a material from a resource 
go.property("my_material", resource.material())
go.property("my_texture", resource.texture())

function init(self)
    material.set_textures(self.my_material, {
        my_texture = self.my_texture
    })
end
elements.name: material.set_textures

parameters.doc: A table keyed by sampler name with texture resources as values.
parameters.name: textures

elements.brief: sets vertex attributes in a material
elements.description: Sets vertex attributes in a material, if the vertex attributes exist.
elements.examples:
Configures a vertex attribute in a material specified as a resource property 
go.property("my_material", resource.material())

function init(self)
    material.set_vertex_attributes(self.my_material, {
        tint_attribute = { value = vmath.vec4(1, 0, 0, 1), semantic_type = graphics.SEMANTIC_TYPE_COLOR },
        weights        = { value = vmath.vec4(0, 1, 0, 0), semantic_type = graphics.SEMANTIC_TYPE_NONE }
    })
end

parameters.doc: Vertex attributes keyed by name, or an array with explicit name fields. Partial updates are supported.

elements.description: A vertex attribute value accepted by material.set_vertex_attributes and returned by material.get_vertex_attributes. Use a number or vector for scalar and vector attributes, matrix4 for a 4x4 matrix, and a flat array of numbers for matrix shapes that do not map to matrix4.
elements.examples:
material.set_vertex_attributes(self.material, {
    tint = { value = vmath.vector4(1, 0, 0, 1) },
    transform_2d = { value = { 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1 } }
})
